title: GBClaw: An agentic AI framework for atomistic grain boundary research and mechanistic discovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.28629v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems hold immense potential for automating complex workflows in materials discovery and design, but extending them to domain-intensive mechanistic investigations remains challenging. Here, we present GBClaw, an agentic AI framework for investigating the structure and deformation of general grain boundaries (GBs). Although general GBs constitute the vast majority of real-world interfaces in polycrystalline materials, they remain understudied because their structural complexity and interfacial mismatch complicate experimental and modeling research. GBClaw integrates large language models (LLMs) into a modular architecture comprising an orchestrator, specialized agents, domain-specific tools, simulation interfaces, and hierarchical memory. Through dynamic replanning and iterative workflow refinement, the framework effectively connects systematic simulations with targeted mechanistic analysis. Applie

translated_title: GBClaw：一个用于原子尺度晶界研究与机理发现的智能体AI框架
translated_abstract: 智能体人工智能（AI）系统在自动化材料发现与设计中的复杂工作流程方面具有巨大潜力，但将其扩展到领域知识密集型的机理研究仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出了GBClaw，一个用于研究一般晶界（GB）结构与变形的智能体AI框架。尽管一般晶界构成了多晶材料中真实界面的绝大部分，但由于其结构复杂性和界面失配使实验与建模研究变得困难，相关研究仍然不足。GBClaw将大语言模型（LLM）集成到一个模块化架构中，该架构包括编排器、专业化智能体、领域专用工具、模拟接口和分层记忆。通过动态重规划与迭代式工作流程优化，该框架有效地将系统性模拟与有针对性的机理分析相结合。
tldr: GBClaw是一个将大语言模型集成到模块化智能体架构中的AI框架，通过动态重规划将系统性原子模拟与有针对性的机理分析相结合，实现了对一般晶界结构与变形的自动化研究和机理发现。
en_tdlr: GBClaw is an agentic AI framework that integrates LLMs into a modular architecture with dynamic replanning, connecting systematic atomistic simulations with targeted mechanistic analysis to enable automated study and mechanistic discovery of general grain boundaries.
